sources.title: Solving Context Window Overflow in AI Agents - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The tool result is subsequently incorporated into the LLM's context window (i.e., the information that is in fact considered by the LLM when generating a response), thereby enabling it to reason over this augmented information - either for directly answering the user request, or use it for further processing (by another tool, for instance).
